description: Phase 4 sweep P1: MerLin photonic ADAPTATION of the context-conditional predictor (candidate M3 of the Phase 4 assessment) at T = 3, 5, 6 with horizon 1, raw and MA5 data. Variants: 1 photon, 2 distinguishable photons, 2 indistinguishable photons with photon-number-resolving detection, 2 indistinguishable photons with threshold detection. Classical baselines rerun under the same labels. Evaluation matrix: no winner selected.

evaluation.split: test = chronological last 20 % of T + 1 windows
evaluation.checkpoint: final step for photonic models; validation-selected refit for baselines
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
